functions.name: addTransform
functions.example:
RiScript.addTransform("uc", (s) => s.toUpperCase());
const rs = new RiScript();
result = rs.evaluate("[hello].uc()");
functions.description: Registers a new transform function that may then be used in RiScript evaluations. Transform functions accept and return strings.

parameters.desc: the function to call, which should accept and return a string

functions.name: removeTransform
functions.description: Removes a previously registered transform function by name.

parameters.desc: the name of the transform to remove

functions.name: getTransforms
functions.description: Returns the names of all currently registered transform functions.

returns.desc: names of all registered transform functions

functions.name: evaluate
functions.example:
// Static

RiScript.evaluate("He was [happy | sad | indifferent]");
RiScript.evaluate("He was [happy | sad | $emo]", context);

// Instance

riscript.evaluate("He was [happy | sad | indifferent]");
riscript.evaluate("He was [happy | sad | $emo]", context);
functions.description: Parses and executes a RiScript string. Available as either a static or instance function.

parameters.desc: the context for any referenced variables or functions (optional)

(optional) options

{boolean} options.trace:
if true, output verbose log to console for debugging (default=false)

{boolean} options.onepass:
if true, run only one pass through engine(default=false)

{boolean} options.v2Compatible:
if true, use RiScript v2-compatible syntax (default=false)
